description: This PHP script seeds quote data into the SuiteCRM system, creating Quote objects with associated product bundles, products, and notes based on predefined seed data.

classes.name: Quote
classes.description: Represents a quote entity in SuiteCRM, used to store quote details and relationships.

classes.name: ProductBundle
classes.description: Represents a product bundle associated with a quote, containing multiple products.

classes.name: ProductBundleNote
classes.description: Represents notes attached to a product bundle.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Represents a product item linked to a quote or bundle.

methods.name: set_productbundle_product_relationship
methods.description: Establishes relationship between a product bundle and its products.

methods.name: set_product_bundle_note_relationship
methods.description: Links a note to a product bundle.

methods.name: set_productbundle_quote_relationship
methods.description: Associates a product bundle with a quote.
